title: TopoPrune: Robust Data Pruning via Unified Latent Space Topology
abstract: arXiv:2602.02739v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Geometric data pruning methods, while practical for leveraging pretrained models, are fundamentally unstable. Their reliance on extrinsic geometry renders them highly sensitive to latent space perturbations, causing performance to degrade during cross-architecture transfer or in the presence of feature noise. We introduce TopoPrune, a framework which resolves this challenge by leveraging topology to capture the stable, intrinsic structure of data. TopoPrune operates at two scales, (1) utilizing a topology-aware manifold approximation to establish a global low-dimensional embedding of the dataset. Subsequently, (2) it employs differentiable persistent homology to perform a local topological optimization on the manifold embeddings, ranking samples by their structural complexity. translated_title: TopoPrune：通过统一潜在空间拓扑实现鲁棒的数据剪枝
translated_abstract: 几何数据剪枝方法虽然在利用预训练模型方面十分实用，但本质上是不稳定的。它们对外在几何的依赖使其对潜在空间扰动高度敏感，导致在跨架构迁移或存在特征噪声的情况下性能下降。我们提出了TopoPrune，一个通过利用拓扑来捕获数据稳定内在结构从而解决这一挑战的框架。TopoPrune在两个尺度上运行：（1）利用拓扑感知的流形近似来建立数据集的全局低维嵌入；随后（2）采用可微持续同调（persistent homology）对流形嵌入进行局部拓扑优化，依据结构复杂度对样本进行排序。我们证明了这种统一的双尺度拓扑方法能够确保高准确度和精确度，尤其是在大幅度的数据集剪枝率下表现尤为突出。
tldr: TopoPrune通过全局拓扑感知流形嵌入与可微持续同调局部优化相结合的双尺度拓扑方法，捕获数据的内在稳定结构，实现对潜在空间扰动鲁棒的数据剪枝，即使在高剪枝率和特征噪声下仍能保持高精度。
en_tdlr: TopoPrune introduces a unified dual-scale topological framework—combining global topology-aware manifold embedding with differentiable persistent homology optimization—to capture intrinsic data structure, enabling robust data pruning that maintains high accuracy even at aggressive pruning rates and under feature noise.
